description: This file contains implementations of distributed tensor operations related to convolution functions for PyTorch, including rules for propagating tensor specifications in distributed settings.

classes.name: OutputSharding
classes.description: A class representing the sharding configuration for tensor outputs in distributed operations.

classes.name: TensorMeta
classes.description: A class encapsulating metadata about tensor shapes, strides, and data types.

methods.name: OutputSharding convolution_rules(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Defines rules for propagating tensor specifications through the convolution operation in a distributed context.

methods.name: OutputSharding convolution_backward_rules(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Defines rules for propagating tensor specifications through the backward convolution operation in a distributed context.
